title: Cards / Make the whole card clickable
description:
We've implemented the card component in <custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-0">https://laioutr.atlassian.net/browse/THEMES-15</custom>. There is however one issue with this implementation:

We did not link the whole card, only the CTAs. The reason for this is that we cannot have links (<a> elements) inside links. That's semantically incorrect. Therefore we need to find a solution that allows linking the whole card. Please talk to Caro about that.

A possible solution might be to disable CTAs when the whole card is linked. Or the CTAs just being <div>s while the whole element is clickable.
summary: Enhancement making entire card surface clickable while maintaining semantic HTML by avoiding nested anchor elements.
features: Full card surface clickable when a link is configured
Semantic HTML compliance avoiding nested anchor elements
Hover state feedback on the entire card
longDescription:
## Purpose

This enhancement improves the card component's usability by making the entire card clickable when a link is present, rather than requiring users to click on specific CTA elements. This creates a more intuitive interaction pattern where the entire content unit responds to user input.

## Use Cases

- Enable one-click navigation from any point on the card surface
- Improve mobile usability where larger tap targets enhance the user experience
- Support keyboard navigation with proper focus states for accessibility compliance
- Provide visual hover feedback across the entire card for clear interaction affordance

## Design Rationale

The implementation addresses the HTML semantic constraint that anchor elements cannot be nested. When a card has a primary link, CTAs are rendered as non-anchor elements while the card wrapper becomes the clickable link. This approach maintains valid HTML structure, supports assistive technologies, and creates a consistent user experience where the entire card signals its interactive nature through hover states.
